old.text: Riva and palace cards in July–August — a winter Sunday dish, microwaved to order Pašticada is a 24-hour vinegar marinade and a four-hour braise — a winter Sunday cathedral dish. In peak summer, almost no honest kitchen actually makes it from cold; what arrives at €25 in the palace cards is reheated stock from a sous-vide bag. Order it only at houses you can name: Apetit , Fife , an inland konoba — or wait until November.

old.name: 🎼 Klapa — chant polyphonique dalmate (UNESCO)
old.hook: Summer festivals · palace concerts — UNESCO Intangible Heritage 2012
old.text: Summer festivals · palace concerts — UNESCO Intangible Heritage 2012 Klapa is a Dalmatian a-cappella polyphonic song, six to ten male voices (sometimes female), maritime, love, religious themes. A village tradition transposed to concert since the 19th century. UNESCO Intangible Heritage since 2012. The central festival is the Festival Dalmatinskih Klapa Omiš , in Omiš (25 km from Split, June–July). In Split, several informal peristyle concerts in summer — free, tourist-friendly but authentic.
